lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; the reviewer read the label only. The bank help of royalty.amt10, shown with the question, says 'Not fees to defend or protect your ownership, recover the property, or develop or improve it: those are added to its cost, not deducted now', which is i1040se Line 10's exclusion (the finding of 2026-11-15, BUG-0922, is fixed).

Ruling: representation; as the ruling of 2026-11-15: folding the expenses of lines 5 to 18 other than 10 and 16 into line 19 leaves line 20 and line 21 unchanged. The exclusion of the filer's own labor and of capital items is in the bank help of royalty.amt19 ('Not the value of your own work, and not something that lasts more than a year'), BUG-0922 fixed.

Ruling: model error; a 2025 loss with amounts not at risk is refused on royalty.loss_abs (when royalty.not_at_risk_if_loss: 'A royalty loss with an amount not at risk is outside this tool'), which the reviewer did not read; royalty.at_risk_prior adds the earlier-year case (p925 p. 19).
